description: Confidential and affordable therapy online, from a Melbourne based Australian counsellor, specialising in individual, grief and loss, and ADHD counselling.

name: Sean Menere
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 1)
description: If you think things could be better, you're probably right. It's hard to ignore that voice inside us that's looking for the right person to help us take the first steps. I specialise in working with anyone facing challenges including, but not limited to: - depression, - anxiety, - stress and anger management, - relationship difficulties/divorce, - major life transitions, - trauma, - abuse, - grief and loss, - illness and major injury, I know how helpful it is to have someone who not only understands, but has both the personal experience with what it takes to get to a place where 'better' is an option, combined with the professional expertise to get you there.

name: Stephanie Schiftan
title: Counsellor (ACA Level 2)
description: I'm a specialist couples and relationship therapist based in Melbourne, holding a Master of Counselling (Couples Stream) and advanced training in integrative couple therapy through Relationships Australia. Before becoming a therapist, I worked extensively in education and hold a Bachelor of Fine Arts. I work with couples at all stages and warmly welcome LGBTQI+ clients and diverse relationship structures.
